desc:
🦈 SHARK BARRY'S PRISON RUN! (OBBY)

The prison is FLOODED and Barry has turned into a MEGALODON! 🌊
Swim, jump and climb your way out before Megalodon Barry catches you in the water. Escape the cell, sneak past the guard hall, survive Garry the Chef's kitchen and beat Barry's Mech Robot to get to freedom!

🦈 Unlock the SHARK BARRY morph and swim faster than everyone
🎁 Like & favorite the game for a FREE reward
⭐ Easy , speedrun records, hidden hats and daily rewards

Genre: Obby & Platformer



Tags: Obby, Escape, Scary, Horror, Adventure, Platformer, Water,  Barry, Prison Run, Shark, Megalodon, Obby, Escape, Flooded, Water, Morph.
